(i) The new spin-1 resonant spectrum is described in terms of two parameters: the mass of the lightest spin-1 triplet and its coupling to a pair of top quarks; (ii) the effective coupling of the new spin-1 triplets to the top quark is related to the mass of the top quark and the new physics scale.
we have constructed an effective theory for strong dynamics, including the spin-1 resonant sector.

(i) the new strong interactions are characterized by a single scale, the mass of the lightest triplet of spin-1 particles, (ii) the couplings of the spin-1 resonant states to SM fields are fixed in terms of a single parameter, and (iii) the couplings among the spin-1 triplets are fixed in terms the mass of the triplet with the largest mass.

the spin-1 resonant spectrum and the spin-0 spectrum are correlated.
